{{Wireless adapter |brand=Microsoft |model=1399 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=04/08/2011 |manuf_country=China |is_manuf=No |manuf=Askey |manuf_model=WLU6150 |manuf_rev=-D68 rev 4 |availability= |if=USB (non-standard connector) |if_bus_version=2.0 |if_connector_type= |form_factor=internal wireless module |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=C3K1399 |ic_id=3048A-1399 |chip1_brand=Atheros |chip1_model=AR9271 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips=SPI Flash (8 Mbit);Macronix;MX25L8006EMII-12G;MXIC, 25L8006E, MII-12G;1; |accessible_UART=Yes |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui=24:EC:99 |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} The FCC documents would indicate that this was meant to be used as an internal wireless module for some Xbox 360 models.
